title: Special-purpose roofs.
officialText: Roof gardens, marquees, and roofs used for promenade, assembly or other special purposes shall be designed for a minimum live load, Lo, as specified in Table 1607.1. Such live loads are permitted to be reduced in accordance with Section 1607.9. Live loads of 100 psf (4.79 kN/m2) or more at areas or roofs classified as Group A occupancies shall not be reduced.
